hero_alt: Clutch assembly from the Autologic range for UAE buyers
hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for UAE traders, distributors and assemblers. We export clutch systems, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings.

Dubai and Abu Dhabi are major trading centres for spare parts, serving local delivery fleets and buyers across the region. Delivery motorcycles in the UAE run long shifts in intense heat, so parts must resist high temperatures. Browse our range below. Every component is tested before dispatch, and our team can help you plan a range for onward sale.

network.title: Why UAE Traders Source From Us
paras: We have more than 25 years of manufacturing experience and test every component before dispatch.
A single manufacturer for clutch, brake, engine and casting lines makes it easier to build a complete catalogue for your customers.

network.title: Shipping Parts to the UAE
paras: Orders travel by sea in palletised export packing to the UAE port you choose, with complete documents for customs.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the UAE market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to the UAE. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order.

faq_intro: Quick answers for traders, distributors and assemblers in the UAE. Our export team replies to trade enquiries with fitment notes and clear commercial terms.
faqs: Can you pack parts under our own brand?
Yes. We offer private label packaging with your brand and part numbers.
Do you supply both two and three wheeler parts?
Yes. Our range covers two and three wheeler clutch parts, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings.
Can you make parts to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Yes. Samples let you check fit and finish before ordering in volume.
Do your parts cope with high temperatures?
Our friction materials and clutch assemblies are rated for up to 300°C continuous endurance, and aluminium housings help dissipate heat.
Can you ship regularly for a trading business?
Yes. Repeat shipments can be scheduled to keep your fast-moving lines in stock.
Do you supply three-wheeler parts for re-export?
Yes. Many UAE traders source our three-wheeler clutch, brake and engine parts to supply buyers in other markets.
